name: block-wordmark
title: Block Wordmark
description: A wordmark builds out of solid blocks — a square scales in, a coloured deck fans out around it and winds back, the stack collapses and stretches into one block per letter, then each block flashes a colour and swaps for its real letterform.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/block-wordmark?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
